The pricing of Acme Cloud Platform is billed monthly on a per-service basis. 

- Acme Run costs $0.000024 per vCPU-second plus $0.0000025 per GiB-second of memory. The free tier includes 180,000 vCPU-seconds per month.
- Acme Queue costs $0.40 per million messages published. The first million messages each month are free.
- Acme Vault costs $0.03 per secret per month, with no free tier.

Annual prepayment reduces the total bill by 15%. There are no charges for data transfer between services inside the same region.
